_tile: The Starry Night, station 8, and the canvas the curl measurement is for. The three regions disagree on purpose: vortex is the double swirl in the upper middle, which is the whole claim; cypress is the flame at the left edge, where the strokes are long and nearly parallel and curve without ever closing; village is the town under the hills, short dabs with no curl in them at all, which is the control that lives on the same canvas.
